take.title_zh: 「AI 即介面」浪潮全面到來，設計師工作流正在被重寫
take.title_en: AI As Interface: The Design Workflow Is Being Rewritten
take.body_zh:
本週 AI 與設計工具的整合加速：Figma 引入 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 雙引擎、OpenAI 為 Codex 新增 Product Design Plugin、Google I/O 宣告「AI 即介面」新時代。從 Figma Make、Sites 到 Dev Mode，整個設計堆疊正在朝「想法即成品」靠攏，設計師在工具鏈裡的角色從執行者轉為決策者。

Config 2026（6/24–25）即將開幕，Figma 可能再度大刀闊斧更新功能。6 月多家 AI 大廠密集發布新模型（Anthropic、Google、xAI、OpenAI），設計師面對的工具與提示選項越來越多——判斷力比操作熟練度更重要。
take.body_en:
The convergence of AI and design tooling is accelerating: Figma now runs OpenAI and Anthropic engines natively, OpenAI's Codex shipped a Product Design Plugin, and Google I/O declared AI the new interface layer. The whole stack — Make, Sites, Dev Mode, Weave — is collapsing the gap between idea and shipped product.

With Config 2026 landing June 24–25, another wave of Figma updates is imminent. June has already seen major model launches from Anthropic, Google, xAI, and OpenAI. For designers, knowing which tool to reach for and when is now the core competency.

articles.title_zh: 6 月 AI 發布潮：Builder 的決策地圖
articles.title_en: June 2026 AI Launch Wave: A Builder's Decision Map
articles.summary_zh: Anthropic、Google、xAI、OpenAI 在 6 月密集發布新模型，形成近年罕見的多方同台競爭格局。WaveSpeed 整理這波 AI 軍備競賽的決策地圖，分析各模型在速度、推理深度、成本與工具整合上的差異，幫助開發者與設計師選擇最適合其產品場景的模型組合。Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5（具 1M token 上下文窗口）是其中最受矚目的推理模型之一，在長文件理解與多步驟設計任務上表現亮眼。
articles.summary_en: June 2026 saw a rare multi-lab AI release sprint: Anthropic, Google, xAI, and OpenAI all shipped notable models in quick succession. WaveSpeed maps out key differentiators — speed, reasoning depth, cost, and tool integration — to help builders and product designers choose the right model stack. Anthropic's Claude Fable 5, a 1M-context reasoning model, stands out for long-document comprehension and multi-step design tasks.
articles.take_zh: 多模型同台讓選擇比技術本身更難。設計師與 PM 現在要的不只是「會用 AI」，而是知道在什麼情境該選哪個模型——這是 2026 年的新設計素養。
articles.take_en: With multiple frontier models releasing simultaneously, model selection is itself a design decision. Knowing which AI to reach for — and when — is becoming core product design literacy.

articles.title_zh: Figma 攜手 OpenAI 與 Anthropic，推出自研 AI 設計 Agent
articles.title_en: Figma Partners With OpenAI and Anthropic to Launch In-House AI Design Agent
articles.summary_zh: Figma 宣布同時整合 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 兩大 AI 引擎，推出原生 AI Design Agent。這個 Agent 可在 Figma 工作流內自動執行多步驟設計任務：佈局建議、元件生成到品牌一致性檢查。與過去的 AI 輔助功能不同，此次以「Agent 模式」主動完成任務，設計師只需審核與修改，大幅縮短從概念到可交付稿的時間。支援雙引擎讓使用者可依任務切換最適模型。
articles.summary_en: Figma unveiled an in-house AI Design Agent powered by both OpenAI and Anthropic models. Operating in true agent mode — not just autocomplete — it autonomously handles multi-step tasks: layout suggestions, component generation, and brand consistency checks. Designers review and approve rather than execute, compressing concept-to-deliverable time significantly. Dual-engine support lets teams switch models based on task type.
articles.take_zh: 設計 Agent 正式登場意味著 Figma 不只是工具，而是設計流程的共同執行者。PM 與設計師的職責邊界將因此重新定義。
articles.take_en: An agentic Figma isn't just a smarter tool — it's a co-executor in the design process. The boundary between PM direction and designer execution is about to blur considerably.

articles.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 Product Design Plugin：原型圖幾分鐘內匯入 Figma
articles.title_en: OpenAI Product Design Plugin: Prototype to Figma in Minutes
articles.summary_zh: OpenAI 為 Codex 推出 Product Design Plugin，讓使用者在 ChatGPT 介面描述產品需求後，幾分鐘內即可生成可直接匯入 Figma 的原型框架。支援 Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 方案，大幅壓縮傳統需要數週的設計發現與線框稿階段。對 PM 而言，這意味著可在早期與工程師、設計師對齊時提供更具體的視覺依據，而非單靠 PRD 文字說明。
articles.summary_en: OpenAI's Product Design Plugin for Codex lets users describe a product in natural language and export a Figma-ready prototype within minutes. Available on Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise tiers, it collapses weeks of discovery and wireframing. For PMs, it provides concrete visual artifacts for early stakeholder alignment — a significant upgrade from text-only PRDs.
articles.take_zh: 當 AI 可以直接輸出 Figma 原型，設計師的價值將更集中在系統判斷與品牌決策，而非框架繪製。低保真溝通的門檻幾乎歸零。
articles.take_en: When AI outputs Figma-ready prototypes, low-fidelity communication no longer requires a dedicated designer. The value of design expertise shifts toward systems thinking and brand judgment.

articles.title_zh: Figma Release Notes：2026 年 6 月最新功能更新
articles.title_en: Figma Release Notes: June 2026 Latest Updates
articles.summary_zh: Releasebot 持續追蹤 Figma 每週功能更新。6 月重點包含：Figma Design Agent 新增 web search 功能，可在設計流程中直接引入網路內容與最佳實踐；Make 與 Sites 的穩定性改善；Dev Mode 的 AI 程式碼建議增強。這些更新持續推進 Figma「整個工作流在單一工具內完成」的願景，對以 Figma 為主力工具的設計師與前端工程師尤其值得關注。Config 2026（6/24–25）前的密集更新節奏也顯示 Figma 有備而來。
articles.summary_en: Releasebot's running Figma update tracker highlights June additions: the Design Agent now supports web search, pulling live context into the canvas; Make and Sites received stability improvements; Dev Mode's AI code suggestions were enhanced. The dense pre-Config update cadence signals Figma is building toward a major reveal on June 24–25.
articles.take_zh: Design Agent 加入 web search 是個訊號：Figma 正從靜態繪圖工具進化為即時情境感知的設計夥伴，這是設計工具史上的重要轉折。
articles.take_en: Web search in the Design Agent marks a genuine shift — Figma is evolving from a static canvas into a context-aware design partner that understands the real world as you work.

articles.title_zh: Google I/O 2026：AI 即介面，數位員工時代即將來臨
articles.title_en: Google I/O 2026: AI Is the Interface — Digital Employees Are Coming Next
articles.summary_zh: Google I/O 2026 的核心訊息：AI 不只是功能，而是整個產品介面的新基礎層。Google 展示跨 Search、Workspace、Android 的 AI Agent 深度整合，暗示下一波產品設計不再以頁面或畫面為中心，而是以「任務」與「意圖」為中心。Anima 的分析指出，設計、程式碼、生產力工具的邊界在 I/O 後已越來越模糊，設計師需要重新思考「一個產品的完整體驗」的定義。
articles.summary_en: Google I/O 2026's headline: AI isn't a feature — it's the new interface substrate. Google demonstrated deep AI Agent integration across Search, Workspace, and Android, signaling a shift from screen-centric to intent-centric product design. Anima's analysis notes the dissolving boundary between design, code, and productivity tools, pushing designers to rethink what a complete product experience means.
articles.take_zh: 「介面即 AI」讓傳統以頁面為單位的 UXUI 思維開始動搖。下一代產品設計師需要同時理解意圖建模與視覺語言，這是全新的能力組合。
articles.take_en: If AI is the interface, page-centric UX thinking becomes incomplete. Next-gen product designers will need to combine intent modeling with visual language — a genuinely new hybrid skill set.

articles.title_zh: Figma AI 2026 全覽：能做什麼，還不能做什麼
articles.title_en: Figma AI in 2026: Everything It Can Do — and What It Still Can't
articles.summary_zh: LogRocket 整理了 Figma AI 截至 2026 年的完整功能圖：內容生成、圖像編輯、智慧搜尋、UI 草稿、程式碼交付與整站生成。文章也誠實列出 AI 仍無法取代人工的領域，包括複雜的使用者研究判斷、品牌語氣決策與跨文化設計微調。這份清單對正在規劃設計流程 AI 化的設計主管與 PM 有高度參考價值，可作為能力邊界地圖使用。
articles.summary_en: LogRocket maps Figma AI's full 2026 capability set: content generation, image editing, smart search, UI drafting, code handoff, and full-site creation. Crucially, it also catalogs what AI still can't handle — nuanced user research synthesis, brand voice decisions, cross-cultural design adjustments. A practical capability-boundary map for design leads and PMs planning workflow automation.
articles.take_zh: Figma AI 的「能與不能」清單就是 2026 年設計師的價值定位地圖：自動化能做的讓它做，人類判斷不可缺的要加碼培養。
articles.take_en: Figma AI's capability list doubles as a value-positioning map for designers: automate what can be automated, and invest deeply in the judgment calls AI still can't make reliably.
